applies: Title 18-C (Maine Uniform Probate Code), effective 2019-09-01 — see transition_18a.

governing.title: No jury trial; removal
governing.why: No jury trial in Probate Court; removal of issues triable by jury.

considerations.title: No jury trial; removal
considerations.note: Removal is grounded in the right to a jury trial on certain contested issues.

transition_18a: Procedural form under current Title 18-C and the Maine Rules of Probate Procedure; the date-of-death substantive transition rules are generally not implicated, though the underlying estate or guardianship matter carries its own transition posture.
disclaimer: Statutes for consideration only — NOT legal advice and not a substitute for a Maine attorney. Citations point to issues a filler should weigh, not to a conclusion. Verify against current law; which code applies can turn on the date of death (see transition_18a).
